title: Joint behavioral decoding and neural prediction from full spatial imaging fields
goal: Recreate the original findings and separately exceed them on the same source-paper task: Joint prediction of neural images and behavior from neural image history: WFCI1 continuous behavior, WFCI2 binary contact traces, and fUS trial target direction. Neural/continuous predictions are one-step-ahead; fUS direction is decoded from the final trial latent state.
